KRISHA DIAM LIMITED
B2B Diamond Wholesale Platform · www.kdlgia.com

COMPLETE PROJECT TIMELINE
8-Month Development Roadmap — 34 Weeks

Customer Portal · Admin Panel · Sales Team Panel · Inventory · Tech Panel
WITH COMPLETE ROLE-BASED ACCESS CONTROL (RBAC)

Duration: 34 Weeks | Start: April 2025 | Target Handover: November 2025
Prepared by: Teesha Choksi — Technical Lead, KDL
Document Date: April 14, 2026 | Version 2.0

1. Executive Summary
This document outlines the complete 34-week (8-month) development timeline for the KDL B2B Diamond Wholesale Platform — a comprehensive multi-panel web application serving Krisha Diam Limited’s diamond trading operations across 28+ countries with an inventory of 3,000–4,000 GIA-certified diamonds.


1.1 Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Matrix
Every page and API endpoint is protected by role. A user can only access pages assigned to their role. The system enforces this at both the frontend (sidebar/routes) and backend (JWT + guard middleware).


2. Phase Overview — 8 Months at a Glance


3. Detailed Week-by-Week Timeline






The Admin Panel is the control center for KDL management. Only SUPER_ADMIN role has full access. Some sub-pages are shared with ACCOUNTANT and INVENTORY_MGR roles.
From 1st may 
Admin Panel — Complete Page List (18 pages)


Admin Panel — Week-by-Week Build Order



The Sales Panel is for KDL’s Hong Kong sales team and any future remote sales representatives. SALES_REP sees only their own assigned clients. SALES_MANAGER sees all clients and can manage the team.

The Truth About First 7 Days Weight Loss
This is not all fat loss — and that is OK. Losing water and glycogen is how your body starts burning fat in weeks 2-3.
The 7-Day Schedule Overview

Before You Start (Do This Tonight)
Remove from kitchen (give away or hide):
Buy these for Week 1:
Vegetables (eat freely):
Spinach, lettuce, cabbage, cauliflower, broccoli, bhindi, lauki, tori, cucumber, tomato, capsicum, onion
Protein (eat at every meal):
Eggs (30 eggs for week 1 = 4-5 per day)
Paneer (500g)
Tofu (500g)
Fats (small amounts):
Ghee, olive oil, avocado (1 per week), almonds, pumpkin seeds
Other:
Lemon, apple cider vinegar, ginger, garlic, green chillies, coriander, mint
Spearmint tea, green tea
Not buying:
No rice, no roti, no chana (first 3 days only), no fruit (first 3 days only), no dairy (first 7 days), no grains (first 7 days)

What to Drink (Week 1 Only)

The 15-Minute Walk After Meals (Non-Negotiable)
This is the single most effective thing in this plan for PCOS weight loss.
You can do this indoors — walk around your home, up and down stairs, or march in place.

Expected Results Day by Day
These are estimates. Your actual numbers may vary. Do not be discouraged if you lose less — consistency matters more.

How You Will Feel Each Day
Days 2-3 are the hardest. This is sugar withdrawal. Drink extra water, rest if needed, do not give up.

What to Do If...

Day 7 Measurements (Record These)

After Day 7: What Next?

Buy: 30 eggs, 500g paneer, 500g tofu, vegetables (spinach, cabbage, broccoli, cauliflower, capsicum, cucumber, tomato, bhindi, lauki)

Tell someone you are doing this for accountability

Walk 15 min fasted
